How I made it:
- The image generator can't make 4:5 images directly. Its only shapes are 1:1, 16:9 and 9:16.
- So I first made a square version: solid burnt-orange background, a simple cream crescent moon, and bold cream sans-serif text that says "NIGHT MARKET" and "SATURDAY 6–10 PM", with nothing else on it.
- Then I used the image editor to reframe it to 4:5.
- I used qwen-image-2.1 because it handles text well. Together the two steps cost 20 credits.
- The square version is also available if you want it: https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbh9sus04a6ir01jfibuzk7/output-0.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T020630Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
